turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hi, how are you holding up?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I want to start exercising again and I'm stuck between a few options.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Let me lay out all the options first. Don't interrupt.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: The first one is joining the gym near my office, it's pricey but I'd go right after work.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Then there's running outside, totally free, but I tend to skip it when the weather's bad.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: And the last one is a home workout app with short twenty minute sessions I can do in the living room.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: What's stopped you in the past, time, money, or motivation? If it's motivation, the gym after work is probably best because it becomes part of your routine. If it's time, the home app is hard to beat.
